niche_statement: Vertical SaaS for the property trades (insurance claims estimation, roofing/exterior contractor software) whose delivery has stalled on legacy mobile-and-desktop codebases — manual releases, 40+ hour cycle times, pre-AI SDLC — fixed via an instrumented AI-native engineering transformation he has run before (42h to <20h cycle time, +115% PRs/dev, 98% faster releases; self-reported).
edp: An org at ~42-hour cycle times with manual releases ships roughly half the work per engineer of a DORA-elite AI-native peer, silently burning ~$1.8M/year of paid capacity per 20 engineers until a faster competitor takes the roadmap and the category.
expertise_statements: Automate our manual App Store / Play Store release process; mobile releases currently take days of engineer time
Reduce engineering cycle time; pull requests sit in review for days and deployment lead time keeps slipping
Drive adoption of AI coding tools across an engineering team that has not embraced them, and prove the ROI with metrics
Define and own an AI-native SDLC with dashboards for engineering AI adoption and code quality
Establish DORA metrics and engineering KPIs, and hold teams accountable to them
Modernize a legacy .NET / WPF desktop codebase toward modern architecture without pausing feature delivery
Replace slow manual QA regression cycles on legacy applications with automated testing to reach CI/CD
Lead iOS and Android teams building offline-capable field apps for contractors, technicians, or adjusters
Bring our complex desktop product to mobile with near feature parity
Build reliable data sync between desktop, web, and mobile clients for field users on poor connectivity
Turn around an underperforming mobile team through coaching, accountability, and staffing changes
Be our first engineering director and bring structure, metrics, and process to a team that grew without leadership
Ship an AI-powered feature in a vertical SaaS product that customers actually adopt
Build or extend a customer-configurable rules engine for estimation, pricing, or workflow
Deep domain fluency in the Xactimate / property claims estimation ecosystem
Build CRM and job-management workflows for roofing, restoration, and exterior contractors
Grow senior engineers into engineering managers and build a leadership bench
Install agile / modern SDLC practice in an engineering org still working ad hoc
disqualifiers: staffing agency or recruiting firm posting on behalf of clients
consultancy / dev shop hiring billable engineers
hardware-only or embedded-only company with no SaaS product
enterprise with its own deep engineering leadership bench (large public company)
greenfield 0-to-1 founding CTO for a pre-product startup
roles requiring deep ML research or model training expertise
